paras: The Juventud least gecko (Sphaerodactylus oliveri) is a species of lizard in the family Sphaerodactylidae. The species is endemic to the West Indies.
The specific name, oliveri, is in honor of American herpetologist James Arthur Oliver.
Sphaerodactylus oliveri is found in Cuba and the Bahamas.
The preferred habitat of Sphaerodactylus oliveri is forest at altitudes of 0–600 m (0–1,969 ft).
